scope: First count word is one MAD, XOR, AND or OR on eight initial words and arbitrary root-only constants, then SHR of any initial/root-only/count numerator by that count. Any length of T-only suffix may retain all bypasses. This does not cover a count prepared by two instructions, an independently computed numerator, or two non-T instructions.

universal_band.scope: Exactly one SHR; its numerator/count are T-only expressions in the eight stated initials/root-only constants. All other computation is T-only, with all bypasses retained. No restriction on prefix/suffix length. Fixed allowed root0x12345678.
universal_band.first_band_proof: Vary b16..18 with other bits fixed. Every initial/T-prefix low16 is fixed, while target low3 has8 different values. If count low16=c<16, q low3 has at most5 values including clamped0. If c30/31, it has at most4/2; c>=32 gives only0. Hence c16..29 everywhere. Counts can still be>=65536.
universal_band.second_band_proof: Fix b low9 and bits>=19, vary b9..18. All initial/T-prefix low9 are fixed. Because the first band lies below512, it makes c=count low16 constant on this fibre. The exhaustive32768 signature table proves the target has at least387 low9 values for EVERY signature. If c24..29, q is either numerator>>c or0, with at most256 values, a contradiction. Thus c16..23 everywhere, and the actual shift always has count>=16, even on clamped branches.
universal_band.prepared_numerator_proof: For a root-only numerator C, each low9 fibre has a single c16..23, so q is either C>>c or0: at most2 low9 values, contradicting>=387.

affine_count_certificate.proof: For I!=v, reachable I=0,1,8 and the universal16..23 band force A divisible by2^16. If A!=0, write r=v2(A). A small count can only be c=B low16. The congruence A*I+B=c modulo2^(r+1) fixes I parity. The other I parity occurs in at least one entire b0/b19 class, where q is always0 but target parity flips on b16. Thus A=0. For v apply the same proof to effective affine coefficients in b. Every surviving count is a root-only constant, regardless of numerator.

self_shift_proof: For every uint32 t, t>>t=0: for t<32, t<2^t; for t>=32, SHR clamps0.
